title: Clarity and Consistency
slide_intent: Show how separate communications can belong to one institution while doing different jobs. Seeing them together makes their common features easier to judge.
strategic_value: The lab can carry the building’s colors and angular forms into both a formal letter and an event announcement.
demonstration: A gray presentation field combines letterhead, an envelope, cards, a seminar flyer, a news cover and small branded objects. An orange note links the visual family to the building.
practical_value: Compare the mark, accent colors and edges across several pieces when deciding how much identity a new format needs.

content_islands.name: Guidance and source note
content_islands.spec: Place the short introduction at upper left and the building reference near the foot in orange italic type.

content_islands.name: Stationery and objects
content_islands.spec: Arrange overlapping white stationery, cards and small orange and yellow objects against gray. Keep their variations in scale apparent.

content_islands.name: Editorial applications
content_islands.spec: Along the bottom, contrast the seminar flyer’s warm graphic edges with a news cover built around a portrait.
